message.content:
Sure! I’ll draft a 5‑day itinerary for a December trip to New York City. If you have any specific interests (e.g., museums, food, nightlife, budget constraints, accessibility needs, etc.), just let me know and I can tweak it accordingly.

---

## Day 1 – Arrival & Midtown Highlights  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Arrive & check into hotel | Choose a Midtown or Lower Manhattan location for easy transit. |
| **Late Morning** | Visit the **Empire State Building** (skip‑the‑line ticket) | Great skyline views; indoor so weather‑independent. |
| **Lunch** | Eat at **Katz’s Delicatessen** (classic pastrami) | Classic NYC deli experience. |
| **Afternoon** | Walk through **Bryant Park** & visit the **New York Public Library** | Bryant Park often hosts holiday markets in December. |
| **Evening** | Dinner at **The Modern** (Michelin‑star, upscale) or **Taverna Kyclades** (Greek) | Book ahead. |
| **Night** | Catch a Broadway show (e.g., *Hamilton*, *Wicked*) | Book tickets in advance. |

---

## Day 2 – Central Park & Museums  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Stroll through **Central Park** (visit Bow Bridge, Bethesda Terrace) | Consider a guided tour or rent a bike. |
| **Late Morning** | Visit the **American Museum of Natural History** | Great for all ages; indoor. |
| **Lunch** | Grab a bite at **Shake Shack** on Madison Ave or **The Loeb Boathouse** (if you’re up for a scenic lunch). |
| **Afternoon** | Explore the **Metropolitan Museum of Art** | Focus on a few key sections to avoid overwhelm. |
| **Evening** | Dinner at **Café Sabarsky** (Viennese café) or **Le Bernardin** (seafood) | Reservations recommended. |
| **Night** | Walk along the **High Line** (weather permitting) | Enjoy city lights and art installations. |

---

## Day 3 – Lower Manhattan & Statue of Liberty  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Take the ferry to the **Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island** | Book a pedestal or crown ticket early. |
| **Lunch** | Eat at **Fraunces Tavern** (historic spot) or **Eataly Downtown** (Italian). |
| **Afternoon** | Walk through **Wall Street** & visit the **9/11 Memorial & Museum** | Museum tickets online. |
| **Evening** | Explore **Brooklyn Bridge Park** & walk across the Brooklyn Bridge | Sunset views of Manhattan skyline. |
| **Night** | Dinner in Brooklyn (e.g., **L&B Spumoni Gardens** for classic pizza) | Try a local brewpub afterward. |

---

## Day 4 – Culture & Shopping  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Visit the **Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)** | Focus on key works; indoor. |
| **Lunch** | Grab a sandwich at **Ess-a-Bagel** or a quick bite at **Chelsea Market**. |
| **Afternoon** | Explore **Chelsea** & the **High Line** (if not done earlier). | Check out art galleries and boutique shops. |
| **Evening** | Attend a jazz performance at **Blue Note** or **Village Vanguard** | Book tickets in advance. |
| **Night** | Dinner at **Momofuku Noodle Bar** or **Buddakan** (modern Asian). |

---

## Day 5 – Departure & Last‑Minute Sights  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Quick visit to **Times Square** (if you missed it) | Best for photos. |
| **Late Morning** | Brunch at **Sarabeth’s** or **Balthazar** | Classic NYC brunch spots. |
| **Afternoon** | Last‑minute shopping at **Fifth Avenue** or **SoHo** | Pick up souvenirs. |
| **Departure** | Head to the airport / train station | Allow extra time for winter traffic. |

---

### Practical Tips for December

| Tip | Why |
|-----|-----|
| **Dress in layers** | NYC can be chilly (10–15 °F / ‑12 to ‑7 °C) and wind‑y. |
| **Carry an umbrella** | December sees occasional snow or sleet. |
| **Use public transit** | Subway is efficient; consider a MetroCard. |
| **Book tickets in advance** | Popular attractions and Broadway shows sell out quickly. |
| **Check weather** | Weather can change; indoor activities are a good backup. |

---

### Quick Weather Snapshot (NYC, December)

```json
{
  "location": "New York, NY",
  "unit": "fahrenheit"
}
```

(We’ll retrieve the latest data shortly.)

---

Let me know if you’d like to adjust any day, add specific interests, or need recommendations for accommodations, dining reservations, or transportation options. Happy planning!
